text: Basic Electronics Co. Ltd (Al-Asasyah Electronics), the Saudi electronics and appliances distributor that markets the Fisher brand printed on the chest of Al-Fayha's 2026-27 shirt, is a limited liability company owned by its founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj; his sons hold its executive posts (president Qasim Al Arfaj, general manager Hamed Al Arfaj and regional directors).
short: Basic Electronics (Fisher) is owned by founder Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj.

source.name: Basic Electronics Company (al-asasyah.com): About Us
source.quote: Basic Electronics Co. Ltd. is a Limited Liability Company owned by Mr. Mohammad Ahmad Al Arfaj

additionalSources.name: Al-Fayha Club: الفيحاء يوقع شراكة مع الشركة الأساسية (partnership announcement)
additionalSources.quote: وضع شعار الشركة على صدر قميص الفريق الأول لكرة القدم
additionalSources.note: Translation: 'placing the company's logo on the chest of the first football team's shirt'. The announcement names the partner as Basic Electronics for Electronic Devices Ltd (Fisher) — الشركة الأساسية للأجهزة الإلكترونية المحدودة (فيشر).
